Line.zh: 你的伙伴准备去打猎，并承诺一旦捕获猎物或天黑之前就会回来。
Line.en: Your partner prepares to go hunting and promises to return once something has been caught or before it gets dark.
Line.ja: Your partner prepares to go hunting and promises to return once something has been caught or before it gets dark.
